answer: For every name, a deposit of 83 credits, frozen until 7 days after the grading closes leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The counter asks for Yeastbound cask scrubber ale charter first, and a charter cask scrubbers file after scrubbing yard checks is the answer it accepts. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. One saffron, one entry. Every raven is counted once. pigment stays on the record.
